about: Games that open in the games scratchpad (special:games, SUPER+G) by themselves, fullscreen unless an entry says "fullscreen": false. Shipped with SimplyChit: to add one for everybody, add a line here (name, class: a regular expression for the window class, see `hyprctl clients`; optional title). Your own games go in Settings > Games, which writes ~/.config/simplychit/settings.json, not this file.
